caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden table positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The table has a rectangular top with rounded and slightly notched corners, showing a natural brown wood grain texture. The table is supported by a single, turned central column that extends downward to three curved legs, each ending in a slightly outward curl. The wood’s shading suggests a smooth, polished finish, with the grain direction visible on both the tabletop and the legs. There are no additional objects or elements in the image apart from the table itself.
title: Tilt Top Table
